Three.js 0.180.0
https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r180

Vendored from the official npm distribution:
- build/three.core.js
- build/three.module.js
- examples/jsm/loaders/STLLoader.js
- examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js

The example modules import ./three.module.js instead of the package name
"three" so they run directly in a browser without an import map. No other
source changes were made. Three.js is distributed under the MIT License; see
THREE-LICENSE.txt in this directory.
